question: What happens to viewers when a favourite television character is written out of a show?
answer: Many feel a real, if milder, version of a breakup. Jonathan Cohen asked viewers to imagine losing their favourite character: those with the strongest one-sided bonds expected the most distress, as did people anxious in their real relationships. The grief tracks the closeness felt, though the character never knew they existed.
move: A bond can run one way and still be real enough to grieve.
ask: Who do I feel I know well without ever having spoken to them?
source: Cohen, Journal of Social and Personal Relationships, 2004
reference: Jonathan Cohen, Parasocial Break-Up from Favorite Television Characters: The Role of Attachment Styles and Relationship Intensity, Journal of Social and Personal Relationships, 2004
